# FUR ELISE - RIGHT HAND
# playNote() plays a musical note.
# The first number is the MIDI pitch and "beats" controls the note duration.
# 0.25 beats is a sixteenth note, so the opening sounds quick like the original.

# Pickup - the famous E and D-sharp pattern begins.
playNote(76, beats=0.25)   # E5 - begins the famous opening motif.
playNote(75, beats=0.25)   # D#5 - moves one semitone below E.

# Bar 1 - six quick notes continue the main motif.
playNote(76, beats=0.25)   # E5 - returns to E.
playNote(75, beats=0.25)   # D#5 - repeats the chromatic movement.
playNote(76, beats=0.25)   # E5 - completes the E/D# pattern.
playNote(71, beats=0.25)   # B4 - the melody jumps down.
playNote(74, beats=0.25)   # D5 - moves upward.
playNote(72, beats=0.25)   # C5 - moves down toward A.

# Bar 2 - the melody lands on A minor.
playNote(69, beats=0.5)    # A4 - a longer note marks the end of the phrase.
rest(0.25)                 # A short rest gives space before the next notes.
playNote(60, beats=0.25)   # C4 - starts an A minor arpeggio.
playNote(64, beats=0.25)   # E4 - continues the arpeggio.
playNote(69, beats=0.25)   # A4 - completes the A minor arpeggio.

# Bar 3 - the harmony moves to E major.
playNote(71, beats=0.5)    # B4 - a longer melody note.
rest(0.25)                 # Short rest before the next three notes.
playNote(64, beats=0.25)   # E4 - starts the E major pattern.
playNote(68, beats=0.25)   # G#4 - gives the E major harmony its major sound.
playNote(71, beats=0.25)   # B4 - completes the E major pattern.

# Bar 4 - the melody rises back toward the opening.
playNote(72, beats=0.5)    # C5 - held longer to shape the phrase.
rest(0.25)                 # Short pause.
playNote(64, beats=0.25)   # E4 - prepares the return of the main theme.
playNote(76, beats=0.25)   # E5 - jumps back to the high register.
playNote(75, beats=0.25)   # D#5 - restarts the famous E/D# pattern.

# Bar 5 - the main theme returns.
playNote(76, beats=0.25)   # E5
playNote(75, beats=0.25)   # D#5
playNote(76, beats=0.25)   # E5
playNote(71, beats=0.25)   # B4
playNote(74, beats=0.25)   # D5
playNote(72, beats=0.25)   # C5

# Bar 6 - returns to A minor.
playNote(69, beats=0.5)    # A4 - the melody settles on the home note.
rest(0.25)                 # Short rest.
playNote(60, beats=0.25)   # C4
playNote(64, beats=0.25)   # E4
playNote(69, beats=0.25)   # A4

# Bar 7 - E harmony returns, but the melody changes slightly.
playNote(71, beats=0.5)    # B4 - longer note.
rest(0.25)                 # Short pause.
playNote(64, beats=0.25)   # E4
playNote(72, beats=0.25)   # C5
playNote(71, beats=0.25)   # B4

# Ending - resolves back to A.
playNote(69, beats=0.5)    # A4 - resolves the opening section.
rest(1)                    # Leaves space at the end of the phrase.
